issue.title: Raise core floor to include tail_text_by_lines_and_chars required by monitor follow-ups
issue.description: Discovered during sase-x7.3.1 landing verification after integrating a45669b26 (fix(agent): preserve monitor fork context; separate monitor_fork_context plan). That commit introduces an unconditional tail_text_by_lines_and_chars Rust call through src/sase/procs/text_bounding.py and shells/prompt.py without raising the published core floor. At current ae1f91fad, probe_core_floor reports stale_actionable: floor 0.32.25 lacks this binding, first shipped by core 5e60561 in v0.32.26. Raise the pyproject dependency floor to a published release containing the binding and update the lock as required; verify the floor probe plus output-tail/follow-up tests. Size small: exact missing binding and dependency root cause are known. Local source-built 0.32.27 validation passes. This is separate from canonical-producer behavior and from sase-wg, whose imported_source_owner floor requirement is already below the current floor; do not corroborate that resolved older requirement as this new defect. Evidence includes the live probe result.

task_type_fields.impact: A supported published-floor install can raise for a missing required Rust binding while constructing bounded shell output/follow-up prompts. Dev installs on 0.32.27 mask the dependency declaration gap.
task_type_fields.location: pyproject.toml sase-core-rs floor; src/sase/procs/text_bounding.py:45; src/sase/shells/prompt.py:76; a45669b26
task_type_fields.repro: At ae1f91fad run .venv/bin/python tools/probe_core_floor --json --sase-core-dir sase/repos/linked/sase-core: exits 3, stale_actionable, tail_text_by_lines_and_chars missing from declared 0.32.25 and available in v0.32.26.
